actions.label: Check mail service
actions.description: Check that the mail service answers, and which domain it serves.
actions.agent: Check that mail-control answers, and the domain and counts it serves. Changes nothing.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: The domain the service gives mail addresses on.

mailboxes.label: Mailboxes
mailboxes.description: How many native mailboxes the registry holds.

sourceGrants.label: Source grants
sourceGrants.description: How many delegated source grants the registry holds.

actions.label: Set up mail
actions.description: Give the agent its mailbox, and any delegated mail, idempotently.
actions.agent: Set up the agent's mailbox and delegated mail; new keys come back once.

agentId.label: Agent
agentId.description: The agent's id: 2 to 63 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

ownerEmail.label: Owner email
ownerEmail.description: The email address of the family member who delegates their mail to this agent.

source.label: Source
source.description: Where the delegated mail comes from. Defaults to hey when an owner email is given.

sourceTag.label: Source tag
sourceTag.description: A short tag that tells this source's mail apart.

mailboxAddress.label: Mailbox address
mailboxAddress.description: The agent's native mailbox address, such as agent@ouro.bot.

generatedPrivateKeys.label: New private keys
generatedPrivateKeys.description: A JSON object of the new private keys, by key id. The service returns them once: store each value in the owning agent's vault before reporting setup complete.

actions.label: Rotate mail keys
actions.description: Replace the mailbox's or the source grant's public keys with new ones.
actions.agent: Replace the mailbox's or source grant's keys; the old keys stop working for new mail.
